title: Devastator — The Capture of Tantive IV
description: A 144-stud Imperial-class destroyer with a razor-edged armored wedge, recessed machinery trenches, eight twin turbolasers, seven aft engines and the unmistakable T bridge with twin shield globes. The tiny Tantive IV hangs in its tractor beam beneath the illuminated ventral docking bay.

sections.name: Layered diagonal rims and recessed service trenches
